defeats.how: The synopsis only says the Beetle kidnapped Aunt May while she was out doing groceries.

defeats.how: Spider-Man tossed the Beetle into a swimming pool, where his heavy costume sank him to the bottom, letting Spider-Man web him up.
defeats.evidence: Spider-Man manages to defeat his foe when he tosses the Beetle into a nearby swimming pool
